readings.why: AsyncOpenAI(api_key=config['api_key'] <- env OPENAI_API_KEY), no base_url (SDK reads OPENAI_BASE_URL env, defaults to api.openai.com). Model is config['model'] (env OPENAI_MODEL, default 'gpt-4o') or config['vision_model'] (env VISION_MODEL, default 'gpt-4o'), chosen at runtime; 'gpt-4o' and other repo literals (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4, o1...) are catalog ids. Main chat call (__common_get_chat_response), streaming/non-streaming, legacy functions/function_call and n choices.
